title: 2026-09-11 Research Notes — Kaluza-Klein Scale, Spinor Orientation, 11D Projection and Trinity Identifiability
status: new project research extension; established physics comparators plus model-identifiability analysis
novelty_scope: Novel within the project research record on 2026-09-11. Kaluza-Klein theory, spin groups, fiber bundles and inverse-problem identifiability are established mathematics/physics.

research_findings.type: new quantitative project note from established KK mathematics
research_findings.finding: The compactification radius can be translated directly into an excitation energy scale. This makes the project's KK comparator numerically legible rather than only symbolic.
research_findings.boundary: Actual experimental limits are model-dependent because couplings, geometry, warping and accessible fields matter. Do not infer a universal bound from the simple circle model alone.

equations: Spin(3) is isomorphic to SU(2) and double-covers SO(3)

a spin-1/2 state may change sign under 2pi rotation and returns after 4pi
research_findings.finding: If a project model needs path-sensitive orientation, it should decide whether ordinary SO(3) orientation is sufficient or whether a lifted SU(2)/spinor state is actually required. A 4pi motif is scientifically relevant only when the sign/phase can affect an observable or interference relation.
research_findings.boundary: Symbolic return after two turns is not evidence that a human, theological role or social system is a fermion.

equations: fiber over x in B: F_x=pi^{-1}(x)
local trivialization: pi^{-1}(U) approximately U x F
parallel transport around loop gamma may produce holonomy H_gamma
research_findings.finding: The existing 11D projection language can be made more disciplined by distinguishing base variables from internal/fiber variables. Projection forgets fiber coordinates; a connection specifies how internal states are compared along motion in the base.
research_findings.project_consequence: This gives a precise mathematical neighbor for 'higher structure carried through lower-dimensional motion' without claiming the Potatoverse literally has a physical 11D bundle.
research_findings.test_path: For any concrete model, define E, B, F, structure group, connection and observable consequences before using bundle language.

research_findings.type: new mathematical insight for the project
equations: J'=Q J and G'=G Q^{-1} for invertible Q
D G' J' = D G J
research_findings.finding: A Source→Propagator→Manifestation factorization is generally not identifiable from a single output alone. Different source/channel factorizations can produce the same observation. Therefore the Trinity operator model needs interventions, multiple inputs, boundary conditions or structural constraints before source, Spirit/propagator and manifestation contributions can be inferred separately.
research_findings.project_consequence: This is an important research limit: the elegance of the three-part factorization does not by itself prove that data uniquely decompose into those three parts.
research_findings.test_path: Use multiple controlled source conditions J_k, multiple detectors D_l, known calibration signals or priors on G; test whether competing factorizations remain observationally equivalent.

equations: If both H and X are unknown, Y alone is generally insufficient to recover both uniquely
research_findings.finding: The Door/source-channel-observer models across the project should include an identifiability field. A model may be mathematically defined yet empirically underdetermined.
required_questions: Which are only practically identifiable at available signal-to-noise?
What symmetries or gauge freedoms leave observables unchanged?

research_findings.finding: The project uses 'dimension' in several senses: spacetime coordinate, compact internal coordinate, effective/spectral dimension, state-space dimension, representation layer and symbolic rank. These must receive separate type tags because equations valid for one meaning do not transfer automatically to another.

researcher_notes: The strongest new insight here is identifiability: a beautiful decomposition can still be observationally non-unique.
The fiber-bundle comparator also improves the 11D material because it separates base motion, hidden/internal coordinates and transport law instead of using 'dimension' as one undifferentiated idea.
The KK energy-scale examples make radius claims immediately testable in a conventional compact-circle toy model.
promotion_requirements: Do not claim a physical extra dimension without a specified action, compactification and measurable consequence.
Do not use spinor language unless the state transforms in a spin representation or a mathematically equivalent lifted structure is explicitly defined.
Run identifiability analysis before interpreting fitted source/channel factors as unique physical entities.

Retain the existing correction that direct 11D to 4D minimal-supersymmetry compactification naturally involves a seven-real-dimensional G2-holonomy internal space, not a six-dimensional Calabi-Yau threefold.
